import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Load and filter data for task_id=105, actions replace and delete
df = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
subset = df[df['task_id'] == 105]
subset = subset[subset['action_type'].isin(['replace', 'delete'])]

# Drop nulls in MW_delta and SA_delta
subset = subset.dropna(subset=['MW_delta', 'SA_delta'])

# Summary statistics by action_type
summary = subset.groupby('action_type').agg(
    MW_mean=('MW_delta', 'mean'),
    MW_std=('MW_delta', 'std'),
    SA_mean=('SA_delta', 'mean'),
    SA_std=('SA_delta', 'std'),
    count=('MW_delta', 'count')
)
print("Summary statistics for task_id=105 by action_type (replace vs delete):")
print(summary)

# Extract data for t-tests
d_rm = subset.loc[subset['action_type']=='delete', 'MW_delta']
r_mw = subset.loc[subset['action_type']=='replace', 'MW_delta']
d_sa = subset.loc[subset['action_type']=='delete', 'SA_delta']
r_sa = subset.loc[subset['action_type']=='replace', 'SA_delta']

# Perform Welch's t-tests
mw_stat, mw_p = ttest_ind(r_mw, d_rm, equal_var=False)
sa_stat, sa_p = ttest_ind(r_sa, d_sa, equal_var=False)

print(f"\nT-test for MW_delta (replace vs delete): statistic = {mw_stat:.4f}, p-value = {mw_p:.4e}")
print(f"T-test for SA_delta (replace vs delete): statistic = {sa_stat:.4f}, p-value = {sa_p:.4e}")

# Boxplots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 6))

sns.boxplot(x='action_type', y='SA_delta', data=subset, ax=axes[1], palette="Set2")
axes[1].set_title('SA_delta by action type (task_id=105)')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Action Type')
axes[1].set_ylabel('SA_delta')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
